            grace_window: Recent tokens protected from eviction (W_grace).

from carc_kv_eviction import CARCKVEviction


class KVCapture:
    """Captures raw K/V projection outputs for EMA scoring."""

    def __init__(self, model, num_layers: int):
        self._hooks = []
        self.kv: Dict[int, list] = {}
        self.active = True
        for i in range(num_layers):
            attn = model.model.layers[i].self_attn
            self._hooks.append(attn.k_proj.register_forward_hook(self._make_hook(i, 0)))
            self._hooks.append(attn.v_proj.register_forward_hook(self._make_hook(i, 1)))

    def _make_hook(self, layer_idx: int, slot: int):
        def fn(_module, _inp, out):
            if not self.active:
                return
            self.kv.setdefault(layer_idx, [None, None])[slot] = out.detach()
        return fn

    def clear(self):
        self.kv.clear()

    def remove(self):
        for h in self._hooks:
            h.remove()
        self._hooks.clear()


def evaluate_ppl_full(model, tokenizer, samples: List[torch.Tensor],
                      device: torch.device) -> float:
    """Evaluate PPL with full KV cache (no eviction)."""
    total_nll = 0.0
    total_tokens = 0

    for input_ids in tqdm(samples, desc="full-cache PPL"):
        input_ids = input_ids.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model(input_ids, labels=input_ids)
        total_nll += outputs.loss.item() * (input_ids.shape[1] - 1)
        total_tokens += input_ids.shape[1] - 1

    return math.exp(total_nll / total_tokens) if total_tokens > 0 else float("inf")


def evaluate_ppl_eviction(model, tokenizer, samples: List[torch.Tensor],
                          device: torch.device, method: str,
                          budget_ratio: float, gamma: float,
                          grace_window: int, per_head: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate PPL with KV eviction (token-by-token with eviction loop)."""
    num_layers = len(model.model.layers)
    num_kv_heads = getattr(model.config, "num_key_value_heads", None)
    max_pos = getattr(model.config, "max_position_embeddings", 4096)

    total_nll = 0.0
    total_tokens = 0
    total_evictions = 0

    capture = KVCapture(model, num_layers)

    for input_ids in tqdm(samples, desc=f"{method} budget={budget_ratio}"):
        input_ids = input_ids.unsqueeze(0).to(device)
        seq_len = input_ids.shape[1]
        budget = int(seq_len * budget_ratio)

        ema = EMAAnchorManager(
            gamma=gamma, num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
            per_head=per_head and num_kv_heads is not None,
        )
        evictor = CARCKVEviction(budget=budget, grace_window=grace_window)

        sample_nll = 0.0

        # Prefill: process in one shot, compute NLL
        capture.active = True
        capture.clear()
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model(input_ids, use_cache=True)
        past_kv = outputs.past_key_values
        logits = outputs.logits  # (1, seq_len, vocab)

        # Compute NLL for all positions
        shift_logits = logits[:, :-1, :].contiguous()
        shift_labels = input_ids[:, 1:].contiguous()
        loss_fct = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss(reduction="sum")
        sample_nll = loss_fct(
            shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1)),
            shift_labels.view(-1),
        ).item()

        # Compute EMA scores from captured K/V
        if method == "ema":
            layer_scores = []
            for li in range(num_layers):
                if li in capture.kv and capture.kv[li][0] is not None:
                    scores = ema.compute_scores(li, capture.kv[li][0], capture.kv[li][1])
                    layer_scores.append(scores.cpu())
            if layer_scores:
                avg = torch.stack(layer_scores).mean(dim=0)
                evictor.update_scores(avg)
        elif method == "random":
            rand_scores = torch.rand(seq_len)
            evictor.update_scores(rand_scores)
        elif method == "recency":
            recency_scores = torch.arange(seq_len, dtype=torch.float32)
            evictor.update_scores(recency_scores)

        capture.clear()

        if evictor.should_evict(seq_len):
            _, eviction_count = evictor.evict(past_kv)
            total_evictions += eviction_count

        total_nll += sample_nll
        total_tokens += seq_len - 1

        ema.reset()
        evictor.reset()
        del past_kv
        gc.collect()
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    capture.remove()
    ppl = math.exp(total_nll / total_tokens) if total_tokens > 0 else float("inf")
    return {
        "ppl": round(ppl, 4),
        "total_tokens": total_tokens,
        "total_evictions": total_evictions,
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="CARC KV Eviction — Perplexity Evaluation",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=str, required=True,
                        help="Path to HF model directory")
    parser.add_argument("--dataset", type=str, default="wikitext",
                        choices=["wikitext", "c4", "alpaca"],
                        help="Evaluation dataset")
    parser.add_argument("--budget-ratios", type=float, nargs="+",
                        default=[0.3, 0.5, 0.7],
                        help="Budget ratios to evaluate")
    parser.add_argument("--methods", type=str, nargs="+",
                        default=["full", "ema", "random", "recency"],
                        choices=["full", "ema", "random", "recency"],
                        help="Eviction methods to evaluate")
    parser.add_argument("--seq-len", type=int, default=2048,
                        help="Sequence length for evaluation")
    parser.add_argument("--num-samples", type=int, default=50,
                        help="Number of evaluation samples")
    parser.add_argument("--gamma", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="EMA decay rate")
    parser.add_argument("--grace-window", type=int, default=175,
                        help="Grace window size (W_grace)")
    parser.add_argument("--per-head", action="store_true", default=True,
                        help="Use per-head EMA scoring")
    parser.add_argument("--no-per-head", dest="per_head", action="store_false")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=str, default="eval_ppl_results.json",
                        help="Output JSON path")
    parser.add_argument("--gpu", type=int, default=0,
                        help="GPU device index")
    parser.add_argument("--dtype", type=str, default="bf16",
                        choices=["fp16", "bf16"],
                        help="Model dtype")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{args.gpu}" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    dtype = torch.float16 if args.dtype == "fp16" else torch.bfloat16

    print(f"Loading model: {args.model}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model, trust_remote_code=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model, torch_dtype=dtype, device_map={"": device},
        trust_remote_code=True,
    )
    model.eval()

    print(f"Loading {args.dataset} data: {args.num_samples} samples × {args.seq_len} tokens")
    samples = load_eval_data(
        dataset_name=args.dataset,
        num_samples=args.num_samples,
        seq_len=args.seq_len,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
    )
    print(f"Loaded {len(samples)} samples")

    results = {
        "config": vars(args),
        "model": args.model,
        "dataset": args.dataset,
        "results": {},
    }

    # Full cache baseline
    if "full" in args.methods:
        print("\n=== Full cache (no eviction) ===")
        ppl_full = evaluate_ppl_full(model, tokenizer, samples, device)
        results["results"]["full"] = {"ppl": round(ppl_full, 4)}
        print(f"Full cache PPL: {ppl_full:.4f}")
    else:
        ppl_full = None

    # Eviction methods
    for method in args.methods:
        if method == "full":
            continue
        for budget in args.budget_ratios:
            key = f"{method}_budget{budget}"
            print(f"\n=== {method} @ budget={budget} ===")

                model, tokenizer, samples, device,

            if ppl_full is not None and ppl_full > 0:

                )
            results["results"][key] = res
            print(f"  PPL: {res['ppl']:.4f}"
                  + (f"  degradation: {res.get('degradation_pct', '?')}%"
                     if "degradation_pct" in res else ""))

    # Summary
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 60)
    for k, v in results["results"].items():
        line = f"  {k}: PPL={v['ppl']}"
        if "degradation_pct" in v:
            line += f"  (Δ={v['degradation_pct']}%)"
        print(line)

    with open(args.output, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

MATH-500 accuracy evaluation for CARC KV cache eviction.

Tests whether reasoning accuracy is preserved under KV budget constraints.
Uses CARCGenerator for autoregressive generation with per-step eviction.

Input:
  --model: Path to HF model
  --budget-ratios: Budget ratios to evaluate (e.g. 0.5 0.7 1.0)
  --num-problems: Number of MATH problems to evaluate
  --max-new-tokens: Max generation length per problem

  --output: Path to save JSON results

Dependencies: torch, transformers, datasets, carc_utils, carc_generate, carc_kv_eviction

import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import torch
from tqdm import tqdm
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

from carc_utils import load_math_data
from carc_generate import CARCGenerator


def extract_boxed(text: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Extract content from \\boxed{...}, handling nested braces."""
    pattern = r"\\boxed\{"
    matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, text))
    if not matches:
        return None
    start = matches[-1].end()
    depth = 1
    pos = start
    while pos < len(text) and depth > 0:
        if text[pos] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[pos] == "}":
            depth -= 1
        pos += 1
    if depth == 0:
        return text[start : pos - 1].strip()
    return None


def normalize_answer(ans: str) -> str:
    """Normalize math answer string for comparison."""
    ans = ans.strip()
    for old, new in [("\\,", ""), ("\\!", ""), ("\\;", ""), ("\\:", ""),
                     ("\\left", ""), ("\\right", ""), ("$", ""), (" ", ""),
                     ("\\dfrac", "\\frac"), ("\\tfrac", "\\frac")]:
        ans = ans.replace(old, new)
    return ans


def check_answer(generated: str, reference: str) -> bool:
    """Check if generated answer matches reference."""
    pred = extract_boxed(generated)
    ref = extract_boxed(reference) if "\\boxed" in reference else reference

    if pred is None or ref is None:
        return False

    return normalize_answer(pred) == normalize_answer(ref)


def load_math_problems(num_problems: int, seed: int = 42) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    """Load MATH problems with both prompts and reference answers."""
    from datasets import load_dataset

    ds = load_dataset("hendrycks/competition_math", split="test", trust_remote_code=True)
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    indices = rng.choice(len(ds), size=min(num_problems, len(ds)), replace=False)

    problems = []
    for idx in indices:
        item = ds[int(idx)]
        prompt = (
            f"Solve the following math problem step by step. "
            f"Show your complete reasoning and put your final answer in \\boxed{{}}.\n\n"
            f"Problem: {item['problem']}\n\n"
            f"Solution: Let me think through this carefully.\n"
        )
        problems.append({
            "prompt": prompt,
            "reference": item["solution"],
            "level": item.get("level", ""),
            "type": item.get("type", ""),
        })
    return problems


def evaluate_math_budget(model, tokenizer, problems: List[Dict],
                         budget_ratio: float, gamma: float,
                         grace_window: int, max_new_tokens: int,
                         temperature: float, device: torch.device) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate MATH-500 accuracy at a given budget ratio."""
    if budget_ratio >= 1.0:
        # Full cache: use standard generation
        gen = None
    else:
        gen = CARCGenerator(
            model, tokenizer,
            budget_ratio=budget_ratio,
            grace_window=grace_window,
            ema_gamma=gamma,
        )

    correct = 0
    total = 0
    per_problem = []

    for prob in tqdm(problems, desc=f"MATH budget={budget_ratio}"):
        if gen is not None:
            result = gen.generate(
                prompt=prob["prompt"],
                max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                temperature=temperature,
            )
            output_text = result["text"]
            eviction_stats = result["eviction_stats"]
        else:
            input_ids = tokenizer(prob["prompt"], return_tensors="pt").input_ids.to(device)
            with torch.no_grad():
                output_ids = model.generate(
                    input_ids,
                    max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
                    temperature=temperature,
                    do_sample=temperature > 0,
                    top_p=0.95,
                )
            output_text = tokenizer.decode(output_ids[0][input_ids.shape[1]:],
                                           skip_special_tokens=True)
            eviction_stats = None

        is_correct = check_answer(output_text, prob["reference"])
        correct += int(is_correct)
        total += 1

        per_problem.append({
            "correct": is_correct,
            "level": prob["level"],
            "type": prob["type"],
            "generated_length": len(output_text),
        })

    if gen is not None:
        gen.cleanup()

    accuracy = correct / total if total > 0 else 0.0
    return {
        "accuracy": round(accuracy, 4),
        "correct": correct,
        "total": total,
        "per_problem": per_problem,
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="CARC KV Eviction — MATH-500 Accuracy Evaluation",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=str, required=True,
                        help="Path to HF model directory")
    parser.add_argument("--budget-ratios", type=float, nargs="+",
                        default=[1.0, 0.7, 0.5],
                        help="Budget ratios to evaluate (1.0 = full cache)")
    parser.add_argument("--num-problems", type=int, default=500,
                        help="Number of MATH problems")
    parser.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=2048,
                        help="Max new tokens per problem")
    parser.add_argument("--gamma", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="EMA decay rate")
    parser.add_argument("--grace-window", type=int, default=175,

    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.6,
                        help="Sampling temperature (0 for greedy)")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42,
                        help="Random seed for problem selection")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=str, default="eval_math500_results.json",
                        help="Output JSON path")
    parser.add_argument("--gpu", type=int, default=0,
                        help="GPU device index")
    parser.add_argument("--dtype", type=str, default="bf16",
                        choices=["fp16", "bf16"])
    args = parser.parse_args()

    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{args.gpu}" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    dtype = torch.float16 if args.dtype == "fp16" else torch.bfloat16

    print(f"Loading model: {args.model}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model, trust_remote_code=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model, torch_dtype=dtype, device_map={"": device},
        trust_remote_code=True,
    )
    model.eval()

    print(f"Loading {args.num_problems} MATH problems (seed={args.seed})")
    problems = load_math_problems(args.num_problems, seed=args.seed)
    print(f"Loaded {len(problems)} problems")

    results = {
        "config": vars(args),
        "results": {},
    }

    full_accuracy = None
    for budget in sorted(args.budget_ratios, reverse=True):
        print(f"\n=== MATH-500 @ budget={budget} ===")
        t0 = time.time()
        res = evaluate_math_budget(
            model, tokenizer, problems,
